content.comment_body: I can't find instructions anywhere on how to connect [product_name] to the internet so I can use the app. I'm not an expert with computers, but I'm not a beginner either. Is there an easy description available? Or could someone explain it simply so I can research the rest myself? Right now, I'm not sure where to begin! Also, is it possible to access [product_name] from the internet without using KNX/EIB or other interfaces?
Hello, Are you working with [product_name] [article_no]? There is a delivery release for [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name]Soft Comfort [version_no]. Best regards, [user_name]

As mentioned previously, you'll need the [product_name] [article_no] model that supports Ethernet. This makes it straightforward to connect [product_name] to a router. Next, configure the IP address, netmask, and gateway settings in [product_name]. Make sure you know the range of local IPs provided by your router, and set the router's IP as the 'gateway.' You can adjust these network settings only when no program is running, so stop any active program first. Typically, the netmask is set to 255.255.255.0. Assign a unique IP address to [product_name] within your router's supported range, avoiding IP conflicts. If your router uses a DHCP range (for example, addresses above 192.168.1.100), pick a static IP below that range for [product_name], such as 192.168.1.10. Once set up, use [product_name]Soft Comfort to connect over your router using the assigned IP. Test local connectivity before attempting access through the app. For app connectivity on your local Wi-Fi, input the IP address of [product_name] in the app's network field. For internet access, configure router port forwarding: forward port 10001 to [product_name]'s IP (TCP and UDP). Then connect to your external IP from the app. Tools like whatismyip.com can help you find your current external IP. If you need regular access over the internet, having a fixed external IP is ideal; if that's not possible, use a dynamic DNS service so you can always reach [product_name] via a domain name, even if your IP changes. Hope this helps!
Hi, Please check the [document] that I created about a year ago. I hope you'll find it useful. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clear, straightforward steps for connecting [product_name] controllers to the internet and using the related app. The thread discusses the necessary hardware ([product_name] Ethernet-enabled model), basic network setup, and remote access procedures. Overall, individuals with average technical experience find the internet setup process complex and have questions about whether additional communication protocols are required.
